description: Ground-truth blur decisions for the OCCLUDE tuning images. WARNING: these seven images are the SAME set the thresholds in occlude/pipeline/rules.py were fit against, so the pass-rate is TRAINING-SET performance / a regression guard, NOT held-out accuracy. The expect_branch field records which rule branch SHOULD fire, so the harness can verify the decision was reached for the right reason and surface which branches have no labelled positive example.

cases.note: sleeveless dress AND visible hair (live mask: Hat+Scarf:Hair 0:8756) — violates on both counts, either branch is a correct trigger
